result.description:
SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Consultant (ICT Business Analyst – ANZSCO 261111)
Blu Pantera Tech Pty Ltd
Fortitude Valley, Brisbane QLD 4006
Full time
$140,000 – $180,000 per year + superannuation

About position
The SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Consultant is responsible for analysing business requirements, and designing, configuring and implementing SAP EAM solutions that optimise asset management and maintenance processes for clients operating in asset-intensive industries. The role partners with business stakeholders to maximise asset reliability, reduce maintenance costs and support digital transformation through effective SAP EAM solutions, while ensuring project delivery meets quality standards, timelines and client requirements.

Responsibilities
- Consult with clients, users and stakeholders to understand organisational objectives, operational requirements and asset management needs.
- Identify, investigate and analyse business processes, procedures and work practices to determine inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
- Define, document and validate functional requirements for SAP solutions supporting asset management and maintenance operations, and recommend process improvements and system enhancements.
- Design, configure and implement SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) solutions aligned with operational requirements and industry best practice, including asset structures, functional locations, equipment records, maintenance notifications, work orders, preventive and corrective maintenance processes, maintenance plans and maintenance strategies.
- Develop functional specifications, data and process models, system documentation and process maps to support SAP solution design, configuration and development.
- Collaborate with technical consultants, developers and project teams to deliver integrated SAP solutions that meet business requirements and technical standards.
- Apply project management methodologies, principles and techniques to develop project plans, estimate costs, allocate resources and manage SAP EAM implementation activities to achieve project milestones and deadlines.
- Develop and execute test plans, including unit, integration and user acceptance testing (UAT), and coordinate data migration, master data validation, system deployment and go-live activities.
- Prepare user documentation, business process documentation and training materials, and deliver formal training to end users.
- Provide post-implementation support, troubleshoot functional issues and monitor SAP EAM processes and performance to identify improvements.
- Act as a central functional reference point throughout project delivery, liaising with clients, users, project managers, developers and cross-functional teams to ensure solutions meet requirements, quality standards and project objectives.

Skills and Qualifications required to perform the above job role
- Tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems or a related discipline. 
- SAP certification or relevant SAP EAM/PM training is highly regarded.
- Minimum of 5 years' experience implementing and supporting SAP Enterprise Asset Management (SAP EAM/PM) solutions.
- Strong business analysis skills, with the ability to identify business requirements, analyse processes and develop functional specifications, process models, documentation and test plans.
- Experience in project management, with strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills, and the ability to oversee the implementation of complex IT projects.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with technical teams, business stakeholders and end users.

result.description:
IT Senior Platform Engineer position available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for IT Senior Platform Engineer – Microsoft Environment (Global Operations) based in our NSW Office.

THE ROLE

As an IT platform Engineer, you will provide Level 1 and Level 2 support in a Microsoft-centric enterprise environment while also supporting and maintaining the organisation’s Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) platform.

You will act as a key point of contact for end users, taking ownership of incidents and service requests from initial triage through to resolution. In addition to end-user support, you will play an active role in D365 administration, security configuration, user role management, and ongoing platform Maintenance.

Working within Freshservice (ITSM) and leveraging NinjaOne (RMM), you will support Windows endpoints, Microsoft 365 services, Active Directory/Entra ID, Microsoft Defender security tooling, and Dynamics 365 environments. You will contribute to continuous improvement, automation, and operational standardisation across our global IT and business systems landscape.

This role is ideal for a technically capable and customer-focused professional who enjoys solving problems, improving systems, and supporting business-critical platforms in a global support model.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Service Desk & End User Support
Provide remote support for users across Europe and the Americas.
Act as primary point of contact for incidents and service requests logged in Freshservice.
Deliver troubleshooting and resolution for:
Windows 10/11 environments
Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
Office applications and collaboration tools
VPN and basic network connectivity issues
Dynamics 365 user access and functional issues
Ensure tickets are categorised, prioritised, and resolved within agreed SLAs.

Dynamics 365 Administration & Platform Support
Administer and support Microsoft Dynamics 365 environments.
Manage D365 security roles, user access, and permission structures.
Configure and maintain:
Security roles and access profiles
Business units and role-based access controls
Environment-level security settings
Support user onboarding/offboarding within D365.
Troubleshoot D365 functional and access-related issues.
Assist with testing, validation, and deployment of D365 updates and changes.
Maintain environment health, performance monitoring, and basic configuration management.
Coordinate with application owners, vendors, and stakeholders for enhancements and issue resolution.
Ensure governance and compliance standards are maintained across D365 environments.

Identity & Access Management
Administer Active Directory and Entra ID (Azure AD).
Manage user lifecycle processes (onboarding, offboarding, access changes).
Configure and support:
Group memberships
Licensing
MFA and Conditional Access
Mailbox management
Align identity controls with D365 security and access models.

Endpoint & RMM Administration
Monitor and manage endpoints using NinjaOne RMM.
Perform patch management, remote remediation, and system monitoring.
Investigate recurring endpoint issues and implement long-term fixes.
Ensure endpoint compliance with security and configuration standards.

Security & Microsoft Defender
Monitor and respond to Microsoft Defender alerts (Endpoint and M365).
Support security best practices including device hardening and vulnerability remediation.
Escalate and coordinate response to suspected security incidents.
Support security posture across D365 through proper role design, least-privilege access, and periodic access reviews.

Problem Management & Continuous Improvement
Perform root cause analysis on recurring incidents (including D365-related issues).
Contribute to process improvement and service optimisation initiatives.
Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, SOPs, and technical documentation.
Identify opportunities for automation within NinjaOne, Microsoft tools, and D365 workflows.
Support governance and platform optimisation initiatives within the D365 ecosystem.

Collaboration & Global Support
Work closely with infrastructure, cybersecurity, application, and business systems teams.
Provide technical guidance to junior support staff when required.
Support change management, system updates, and release cycles (including D365 updates).
Participate in shift coverage aligned with Europe and Americas time zones.

ABOUT YOU

Experience
3–6+ years’ experience in IT Support / Service Desk / End User Computing roles.
Experience supporting a Microsoft-based enterprise environment.
Hands-on experience supporting or administering Microsoft Dynamics 365.
Exposure to global or multi-site support operations is desirable.
Experience with ITSM platforms (Freshservice preferred).
Experience with RMM tools (NinjaOne preferred).

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Strong working knowledge of:
Active Directory & Entra ID (Azure AD)
Microsoft 365 administration
Exchange Online
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
Windows OS administration
MFA and Conditional Access configuration
Dynamics 365 security roles and access management
Role-based access control (RBAC) principles
Basic networking concepts (DNS, DHCP, VPN)

Certifications (Desirable)
Microsoft certifications (MS-900, MD-102, AZ-900 or similar).
Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (MB-910 / MB-920 or similar).

Soft Skills
Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal).
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a global support model.
Customer-first attitude with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
High level of accountability and ownership.

If you believe you the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Salary: $100,000 per annum + Super

Media Account Service Roles
Trading under Publicis Media Australia
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane

Senior Account Executive (Also known as Senior Planning Executive, Senior Client Executive)

The purpose of the Senior Planning Executive role is to autonomously plan and implement client campaigns -they are ultimately responsible for the delivery of all client activity. They will help lead the delivery of communication plans and management of digital campaigns from buying and implementation through to reporting and the delivery of holistic campaign learnings.  The Senior Planning Executive is to work in collaboration with the wider team to deliver integrated and creative plans that considers all vehicles (display, SEM, SEO, Social) and mainstream media at every possible opportunity. The Senior Planning Executive ensures attention to detail in all facets of their work and will take responsibility for any errors that occur.  Experience required: Minimum 3-4 years’ experience understanding and working knowledge of Australian Media Landscape and digital marketing advertising. Preferably a University degree or higher education qualifications. Expert understanding and working knowledge of Australian medialandscape. Expert across the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Have an understanding and experience using the following tools: eTAM, BMD, Roy Morgan, EMMA, eRAM, Nielsen Digital / Answers, Sizmek and/or DCM, MOVE, AQX Fusion 

Salary:$80 –90k package

Account Manager (Also known as Client Manager, Planning Manager, Associate Account Manager, Associate Client Manager, Associate Planning Manager)
The purpose of the Account Manager role is to create media strategy and implementation recommendations across all media for clients and oversee the delivery of all campaigns.  This role requires skills in creativity, media planning, media marketplace, tools and market dynamics. The Account Manager is also responsible for directly managing any Co-ordinators and Planning Executives within the client team and supporting the senior client leads in managing the client relationship through regular communication, presentations, WIP’s, and financial process.  Experience Required:  3-4 years’ industry experience. Expert across the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Possess sound financial management skills. Strong media understanding including an understanding and experience in using the full suite of media planning and measurement tools.
Salary: $80k-$100k package

Associate Account Director (Also known as Associate Client Director, Associate Planning Director, Senior Account Manager, Senior Planning Manager, Senior Client Manager)

This role is focused around communications planning, account service and leading a team of direct and indirect reports. For this role, we require someone who is comfortable in establishing and owning senior level client relationships and helping drive the client forward in regards to their media/marketing plans. This role also offers you the opportunity to test and learn new things allowing you to be at the forefront of new learning. The purpose of the Associate Account Director is to ensure that client service is of an exceptionally high standard. The Associate Account Director works closely with the Account Director and/or Business Director and/or Group Business Director to ensure that the product delivered to clients is best in class and in line with the agency’s values.  Experience required: 4-5 years industry experience, people management skills, strong written and verbal communication skills , client Leadership ,excellent presentation skills, sound business acumen ,strong understanding of media channels, understanding of media systems.
Salary: $90k-$110k package 

Account Director (Also known as Client Director, Planning Director)
The purpose of the Account Director is to lead the development of media strategy and communication plans across their client portfolio. They are ultimately responsible for their teams work & output. They must ensure attention to detail in all facets of their teams work and take responsibility for any errors that occur. It is expected that they will participate in, embrace and lead training forums for their team and where applicable the common good of the agency. The Account Director is also responsible for developing long-term, mutually beneficial relationships with all clients - they should look to own the Marketing Manager level client relationship, and in some instances at the Marketing Director level. Account Directors will be called on to assist or lead New Business opportunities
Salary: $100k - $130k package

Business Director (Also known as Client Partner)
This role is focused on driving client business relationship and deliver best in class business and communications solutions for clients.  The Business Director role includes: ultimate responsibility in overseeing and managing accounts, manage client expectations, anticipate client needs, resolve issues, identify client business requirements and work with team and cross functional teams to deliver the right solutions. Proactively source and present media / group solutions to help grow your client’s business 
Experience Required:  8-10 years industry experience at the minimum, people management skills, strong written and verbal communication skills , client leadership ,excellent presentation skills, sound business acumen, strong understanding of media channels understanding of media systems.
Salary – over threshold 

Group Business Director (Also known as Client Partner)
Purpose of the role is to inspire and manage the client team and specialists to deliver world class work, service and partnerships. Deliver services and products that drives marketing led growth for our clients. Develop trusted and positive senior client relationships e.g. CMO, Marketing Director and ensure the agency team is acting as a true marketing partner. Develop internal and external client action plans that: Drives you and your team to deliver against client needs in a style which makes your client consider you their most valued business partner.  Identify opportunities to deliver marketing led growth via our diversified service. Custodian of the whole client contract, scope of work and have a plan in place to safeguard any upcoming renewals/negotiations (with General Manager/Managing Director).  Experience Required:  12-15 years industry experience, people management skills, strong written and verbal communication skills , client leadership, excellent presentation skills, sound business acumen, strong understanding of media channels, understanding of media systems.
Salary – over threshold 


All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.

Roles could also be available in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane

Nestled on the edge of the Greater Blue Mountains National Park and Hunter Valley Wine Country is the Salter Brothers Hospitality collection of distinctive luxury accommodations and restaurants encapsulating heritage, indulgence and character at its best.
  
The five properties are unique to the Blue Mountains and Hunter Valley regions and provide an immersive journey through Australia’s most visited tourism destinations.
  
“Echoes Boutique Hotel and Restaurant / Hydro Majestic Hotel / Lilianfels Blue Mountains Resort and Spa / Parklands Country Gardens and Lodge / The Convent Hunter Valley / Spicer Guesthouse Hunter Valley"
  
Salter Brothers Hospitality Group is seeking an experienced Duty Manager/Hotel Manager to join their teams.

Plan, coordinate and participate in all operational activities including food & beverage and front desk/reception activities to ensure all operational activities function smoothly.

result.description:
Voyages Tourism Australia requires 4 workers to work within our Front Office Department as a Guest Service Agent, assisting guests with their luggage, offering information and support and ensuring a smooth and welcoming experience from arrival to departure located in Yulara, NT. 

The day-to-day duties may include:
-Serve as an ambassador of the resort, ensuring all guests feel welcomed upon arrival and are bid farewell with kindness at departure, enhancing guest satisfaction throughout their stay.
- Efficiently and accurately process all check-ins and check-outs.
- Ensure all hotel charges are accurately processed to guests’ accounts, with pre-authorizations taken for each account, guaranteeing bills are correct and payments are securely handled.
- Deliver a high standard of quality service by promptly and effectively responding to all guest inquiries, bookings, and complaints with exceptional customer service.

You will be required to use tools and equipment such as computer, two way radio, telephone, motor vehicle, trolley, vacuum, work individually and in a team with others, and have the ability to work quickly and with accuracy. 

The work is physical, and you may be required to work in a harsh desert environment with temperatures that range from 12 to 45 degrees Celsius.

You will be employed on a full-time basis of $29.63 per hour under the terms and conditions of the Voyages Tourism Australia Pty Ltd Enterprise Agreement 2016 (Resort Worker Level 2) and receive a minimum of 38 hours per week. 

The work is usually performed between the hours of 06:00 to 23:00, Monday to Sunday as this role requires shift work, weekends and Public Holiday’s. 

Work is expected to commence on or around August 2026 for a period of 4 years.

Experience is preferred but not essential, as training will be provided. Successful candidates may also have the opportunity to learn and acquire additional skills during their employment.
 
Candidates should be motivated and be able to learn quickly. 

(This opportunity is with Voyages Tourism Australia, formerly known as Voyages Indigenous Tourism Australia)
